error[ZBX-E0714]: won't write the archive to a terminal
  while  exporting the state volume pgdata
  cause  standard output is a terminal, and the archive is binary data
  volume pgdata
  fix    name a file:   zbx state export pgdata -o pgdata.tar.gz
         or redirect the output: zbx state export <name> > <name>.tar.gz
  more   zbx explain E0714
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0714.html
